title: Home fieldwork guide and tally sheet, with a sample data sheet
subject: Geography
source: Written for geography/y5 lesson 18 (Home fieldwork guide and tally sheet, with a sample data sheet (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 18: Home fieldwork: where does our kitchen food come from?. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out where the food in our kitchen comes from
equipment: 20 foods from your kitchen (packets, tins, fruit labels)
safety: Ask before moving food; put everything back
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Write your prediction: most of our food comes from...
Read the label: look for 'Produce of' or 'Origin'
Draw a bar chart and write a conclusion

questions.a: Answer from the pupil's own data with a reason
